logic_group.name: libplist pretty-print output formatters
logic_group.description: The libplist library includes three distinct "pretty print" output formatters (default, limd, plutil) that each implement their own recursive node_to_string function to walk a plist tree and serialize it into a human-readable string. These are accessed via plist_write_to_string (with PLIST_FORMAT_PRINT, PLIST_FORMAT_LIMD, PLIST_FORMAT_PLUTIL format constants) or plist_write_to_stream. Each formatter recursively traverses the tree via node_first_child/node_next_sibling, handles type-specific serialization (base64 encoding for data nodes, date formatting via gmtime64_r, nested dict/array output), and writes into a strbuf. Fuzzing this path exercises parse-then-serialize round-trips with recursive tree walks and format-specific length handling that differ from the binary/XML/JSON/OpenStep serializers already covered.
